intro: This quest represents the third leg of Captain Sanders' scavenger hunt across the shores of Westfall. Found inside a broken barrel, this parchment directs treasure seekers north toward an old jug resting by a coastal windmill. Following these cryptic directions draws adventurers further along the late pirate's trail toward his fabled stash.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Searching through the barrel you discover another piece of parchment. This one reads: Now from this here barrel, face ye North. Straight as the crow flies, keep ye walkin' till you see the empty jug next to the lone windmill on the sea bluffs. If ye poke around that jug, ye just might find what you're lookin' for.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You're on your way to the jackpot, treasure seeker!
